rec.name: PDP Technical Specifications Accordion with 'Included in the Box' Panel
rec.status: Built — delivered, documentation reviewed (final launch status not confirmed)

what.text: A PDP section titled e.g. 'Tech Specs'. On the left is an accordion of spec categories (e.g. Sound, Design, Battery, Connectivity). Each category opens to a 2-column grid of spec items, each with a bold label and a description below. On the right is a rounded 'Included in the Box' card with up to 6 icon + label items, shown as a 3-column grid in 2 rows (the screenshot shows 5 items: Headphones, Fabric carrying case, USB-A to USB-C cable, 3.5 mm audio cable, Quick Start Guide). A black hang-tab graphic sits on top of the card. The section hides itself automatically when the product has no spec metafield data.

why.text: Detailed specs answer the technical objections of considered purchases (e.g. electronics) directly on the PDP, so shoppers don't have to leave the page or search elsewhere. The accordion keeps the page scannable and avoids a wall of text. The 'Included in the Box' panel makes the scope of delivery concrete and tangible, which reduces uncertainty about what is actually received and reinforces perceived value.

how.text: Create a custom section file (ed-cro-pdp-technical-specifications.liquid) with header, accordion and in_the_box blocks. Content is stored per product in a metafield / metaobject (namespace standard.cro_pdp_technical_specifications) with a heading, up to 4 collapsible categories (title plus items) and box items (icon + label). The section only renders if the metafield exists. Styling is driven by CSS variables set from block settings (separate desktop and mobile values for font sizes, spacing, radius, icon size). Desktop layout is a flex row (accordion + box, 40px gap); below 768px it stacks into a column. The accordion uses a custom ed-collapsible web component with a plus icon that rotates into an × when open. Category content is a 2-column grid. The box can optionally be sticky on desktop. Note: the supplied code is partial and cut off mid-loop, and appears to contain a few bugs (e.g. accordion content size is mapped to the text color setting; --box-icon-siz is misspelled).

items: Headline: rich text (bold/italic/underline), font family, font size, weight, alignment, transform, line height, letter spacing, spacing top/bottom, optional max width — separate mobile values
Sub-headline: same formatting options (per ticket; not confirmed in code)
Text colors (section and block level) and section background color
Accordion: border color, vertical padding, button text color/background, button size/weight, content text color/background, content size — desktop and mobile
Category titles editable; default open/closed state per category; drag & drop reorder of categories; titles bold, description in body text below
'Included in the Box': enable/disable, heading, up to 6 items (icon upload SVG/PNG + label), background color, corner radius, title size, icon size, icon background, label size, optional shadow
Layout: accordion/box width ratio (e.g. 70/30, 60/40), padding top/bottom/left/right, section width, optional custom max width, sticky box
Mobile order: accordion first then box, or reversed

dependencies.text: Product metafield standard.cro_pdp_technical_specifications (metaobject-based) holding the heading, up to 4 category titles with content and the box items. Requires a theme with the custom ed-collapsible / ed-collapsible-wrap web component (Section reference: Shopify theme 'Concept'). Requires product images/icons uploaded for the box items. The section is hidden when metafield values are missing. Metaobject definitions must be created and filled per product.

items: Scroll depth to the spec section
Return rate / pre-purchase support tickets about specs or scope of delivery

images.caption: Reference design (Concept theme): 'Tech Specs' heading, Sound accordion open with 2-column items, Design/Battery/Connectivity closed, 'Included in the Box' card with icons on the right.
Implemented version on a Shopify PDP: same layout with accordion on the left (open Sound category with 2-column spec grid) and 'Included in the Box' card with 5 icon items on the right.
Visible layout configuration: about 60/40 split, plus/× toggle icons, rounded light-gray box with circular icon backgrounds.
